subject: Client Takeoff: week-zero sync, hosts, and meeting links
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@northbridgeanalytics.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Client Takeoff: week-zero sync, hosts, and meeting links

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference rollout. To get week-zero scheduled and the right hosts staffed, can you confirm the two items below?

1) Preferred 60-minute slot (all times PDT):
   - Option A: Mon 9/21 10:00–11:00
   - Option B: Tue 9/22 14:00–15:00
   - Option C: Wed 9/23 09:30–10:30

2) List of Northbridge attendees and their roles (we currently have Sylvia Park (Project Sponsor) and Ravi Menon (Platform Lead) listed). If there are any additional stakeholders who should be invited (security, infra, data engineering), please add them here.

Agenda draft attached (WeekZero_Agenda_v1.pdf). The meeting will include: intros, success criteria review, environment access checklist, routing for sensitive items, and next steps + owners.

Zoom link and calendar invite will follow once you confirm the slot and attendee list. If you prefer to set the time on your side, send an invite to olga.petrov@redwood.com and we'll accept.

Thanks — Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126


From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@northbridgeanalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi@northbridgeanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client Takeoff: week-zero sync, hosts, and meeting links

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the note. Option B (Tue 9/22 14:00–15:00 PDT) works best for our team. Confirmed attendees:
- Sylvia Park — Project Sponsor
- Ravi Menon — Platform Lead
- Jenna Ortiz — Security SME (cc'd on this reply)
- Marco Diaz — Data Eng (tentative)

We prefer the 60-minute cadence. Please go ahead and send the invite. Also, can you add a short pre-read (access checklist) in the calendar invite?

Best,
Sylvia

On Sat, Sep 19, 2026 at 08:20 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great — holding Tue 9/22 14:00–15:00 PDT. I will send the calendar invite with the access checklist attached.
>
> Quick note for internal: Stephanie/Marissa/Vivek — please see attendee list from Northbridge. Jenna is their Sec SME; Marco is tentative. We should plan:
> - Olga: governance + success criteria (lead)
> - Stephanie: runtime/ops orientation (lead)
> - Marissa: onboarding logistics & docs (owner of invites)
> - Vivek: initial mapping of routing/fallbacks (technical consult)
>
> Can each of you confirm availability for the slot and whether you want to be on the invite?
>
> Thanks — O

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client Takeoff: week-zero sync, hosts, and meeting links

Olga —

Thanks, I’m available for Tue 9/22 14:00–15:00 PDT and happy to be on the invite. I’ll prepare the runtime checklist slide (5 mins) and a short runbook section for access items.

Marissa — can you create the calendar invite (Takeoff_Invite.ics) and attach the access checklist + agenda? Also copy the Zoom link below into the invite.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9823456712?pwd=abc123
Drive folder with pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD3eFgh

Stephanie

All —

Invite sent for Tue, Sep 22 14:00–15:00 PDT. Attached: WeekZero_Agenda_v1.pdf and Takeoff_Invite.ics. Zoom link is in the invite.

Sylvia / Ravi / Jenna — please accept when convenient. If you want the meeting notes to go to a specific Slack channel, let me know and I’ll CC the integration.

Looking forward to the session — Marissa

Attachments:
- WeekZero_Agenda_v1.pdf (Agenda + 20-minute block assignments)
